add.label: add
add.help: Adds the value to the current one instead of replacing it.

target.label: target
target.help: The players it acts on: self, all, or a selector object. Unset: the player of the event.

maxAttempts.label: max_attempts
maxAttempts.help: How often a value outside min and max is rolled again.

lootTarget.label: target
lootTarget.help: The ids it applies to. Unset: all of this type. Block states are not allowed here.

overwrite.label: overwrite
overwrite.help: What to remove from the vanilla result: items, experience, all or none (default: add your loot).

lootTable.label: loot
lootTable.help: A loot template with its arguments, a loot table of your own, or the id of another loot table.

template.label: template
template.help: A loot template of CraftEngine or of another pack. default:loot_table/self drops the block itself.

arguments.label: arguments
arguments.help: The values the template fills in, such as item or count.

bonusRolls.label: bonus_rolls
bonusRolls.help: Extra rolls per point of luck.

lootFunctions.label: functions
lootFunctions.help: Change the dropped items, in this order.

lootSourceId.label: id
lootSourceId.help: The id of the loot source. Without a namespace it gets the project namespace.

weight.label: weight
weight.help: How often this entry is picked among the others of its pool (default 1).

quality.label: quality
quality.help: How much each point of luck adds to the weight.

fallback.label: fallback
fallback.help: The value when the entity lacks the vanilla attribute. Default: 0.

transform.label: transform
transform.help: An expression applied to the value read, with value as its variable.
